name: com.nebulacomponents.commerce.checkout
title: Nebula One-Leak Repair Sprint Checkout
description: Creates an audit-bound Stripe-hosted checkout session for the fixed-price $97 repair sprint. A verified audit-unlock cookie is also required.

offerKey.description: Server-recognized offer identifier. Prices and amounts are never accepted from clients.

auditId.description: Completed eligible audit bound to the caller's verified unlock cookie.
